title: NTLinux compatibility database entry
description: Phase 10's 'driver compatibility database' deliverable (ROADMAP.md Phase 10, ARCHITECTURE.md section 46): one entry per tracked application, game, or driver. tooling/compat-db/README.md names the fields this formalizes: version, Windows target, required overrides, known bugs, test status.

kind.description: 'driver' entries are what ties this database to driver/ and tooling/compat-db/ddkgap/'s own findings (ARCHITECTURE.md section 46's driver-compatibility half).

version.description: The tested version of the app/game/driver itself, not of NTLinux.

windows_target.description: The Windows version this was built/documented against, e.g. 'winxp', 'win7', 'win10' — not necessarily what it was tested under here.

required_overrides.description: Wine DLL overrides (WINEDLLOVERRIDES-shaped) this entry needed, if any.

test_status.description: Deliberately one shared enum across kinds rather than a per-kind one (Rule 2): 'builds'/'loads'/'verified' read naturally for a driver entry, 'boots'/'playable'/'perfect' for a game, and both kinds share 'untested' as the honest default — see this schema's README for why a split enum wasn't worth the duplication.

compat_tool.description: For 'game'/'application' entries only: which Steam Play compatibility tool (or ntloader) this was run through.

driver_refs.description: Repo-relative paths into driver/ this entry depends on or exercises, for 'driver' kind entries (or a game/app entry that specifically exercises one, e.g. Phase 5's vsdev.c test).

last_tested.description: ISO 8601 date of the most recent real test this entry reflects — never backfilled from memory, always the date an actual run happened.
